title: Psalm emits this issue when a constant type in a child is less specific than the type in the parent.
summary: Psalm reports it only at error level 1, the strictest level.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a class implements an interface method but its return type is less specific than the interface method return type.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 6 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a return statement is more general than the return type given for the function.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 4 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a return type covers more possibilities than the function itself.
summary: Psalm reports it only at error level 1, the strictest level.
